test_title: SSC MTS 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 04 Nov, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: In February 2023, who was appointed as the CEO of NITI Aayog?
solution:
The Correct answer is __**BVR Subrahmanyam**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **BVR Subrahmanyam** was appointed as the **CEO of NITI Aayog** in **February 2023**.
 
• He is a 1987-batch **Indian Administrative Service (IAS) officer** of the Chhattisgarh cadre.
 
• Before this appointment, he served as the **Commerce Secretary to the Government of India**.
 
• He has held key positions in the government, including as **Chief Secretary of Jammu and Kashmir** during a critical period after the abrogation of Article 370 in 2019.
 
• BVR Subrahmanyam has extensive experience in administration and policy-making, making him suitable for leading **NITI Aayog**, which serves as a policy think tank of the Government of India.
 
• The **NITI Aayog** (National Institution for Transforming India) replaced the Planning Commission in **2015** and focuses on fostering cooperative federalism and promoting sustainable development.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Iyer Parmeshwaran**__

 __
 
• **Iyer Parmeshwaran** is a prominent Indian bureaucrat and former CEO of **NITI Aayog.**
 
• He is well known for his work in sanitation and was instrumental in implementing the **Swachh Bharat Mission** as Secretary of the Ministry of Drinking Water and Sanitation.
 
• He also played a significant role in policy-making during his tenure at NITI Aayog.
 
 
 
• **Monali Jaiswal**__
 __
 
• No significant information is available about **Monali Jaiswal** in the context of NITI Aayog or related positions.
 
 
 
• **Geetika Srivastava**__
 
 
• **Geetika Srivastava** is an Indian Foreign Service (IFS) officer known for her roles in diplomatic assignments.
 
• She has served in various capacities in the **Ministry of External Affairs** but does not have any known association with NITI Aayog.
